text:
ravi: FYI scheduling a short window for a kernel-compat slim swap + quant bias-fix (int8-bias-fix). window 22:00-23:00 UTC. plan: 4% canary -> 30% -> 100%. aiming minimal blast radius. tagging SRE and support.

zoe: +1. preflight checklist please: bundle-sign verify, kv-warm, matmul-smoke. also drop a note if KMS key rotation impacts signing.

deploybot: [scheduled] release job created: rb/kernel-compat-slim-2026-04-10 (canary 4%). ETA start 22:00 UTC. notify=#eng-runtime

samir: I'll run bundle-sign verify. last rotation changed the key alias; will validate against alias redwood-sign-prod. if mismatch -> abort.

sre-oncall: onwatch for 22:00-23:00. PD policy: error-rate >3% OR p99 delta >250ms -> page.

support-lead: I'll prep a short customer note in case anyone sees anomalies: fallback guidance and contact. need fallback name.

ravi: fallback -> engine:compat-stable and engine:compat-slim for thermal. rollback criteria: error-rate +3% OR p99 +180ms sustained 5m. pin TTL=60m with deadman unpin at 23:45 UTC.

samir: bundle-sign verify passed at 21:20 UTC against alias redwood-sign-prod. matmul-smoke and kv-warm warmed at 21:35. good to go.

deploybot: command received: /release start rb/kernel-compat-slim-2026-04-10 --canary=4 --ttl=60m --notify #eng-runtime

zoe: adding a preflight shadow run for 2% traffic for 10m to catch model drift (logs only).

deploybot: [running] canary started at 22:00 UTC. canary=4%. metrics endpoint: /metrics/release/rb/kernel-compat-slim-2026-04-10

sre-oncall: seeing a slight p95 increase +22ms at +3m, no errors. watching traces now.

support-lead: draft note ready: https://docs.internal/releases/rb-kernel-compat-slim-2026-04-10  includes fallback steps and support contact.

ravi: if clean at +15m we shift to 30%. otherwise hold and investigate trace ids shadow-* and smoke-*.

deploybot: [status] promoting to 30% at 22:20 UTC.

sre-oncall: after 30% shift we saw p99 tail spike to +210ms for ~4m, error-rate flat. spike correlates with a small customer shard; isolating now.

samir: isolating noisy shard A12, routing policy patched to send A12 to engine:compat-stable. running targeted rollback test for that shard.

zoe: good call. hold global promotion until shard isolation confirms stable for 10m.

sre-oncall: marking channel monitored. no PD yet. if it repros we abort.

support-lead: notified support and product about isolated shard A12. telling support to apply fallback for any incoming customer reports.

ravi: once A12 is on compat-stable and metrics normalize, we'll complete 100% promote. decision in 10m.

deploybot: [info] traffic reroute for shard A12 applied to engine:compat-stable.

sre-oncall: p99 back to baseline after routing change. +0. core signals stable for 8m. recommend final promote.

ravi: promote to 100% now. clear canary pin after completion and paste final build hash.

deploybot: [done] rollout completed at 22:52 UTC. build sha: sha256:bbccddeeff00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899aa

samir: confirming bundle-sign post-roll passed and logging the signature: sig:sign-2026-04-10-01.

support-lead: final note published and sent to support/product. thanks everyone.

ravi: clearing pin and updating runbook. closing thread :tada:
